QuestInfo.name: Hero of the Story
QuestInfo.1: Took Jay's advice and visited Mrs. Ming Ming to ask about Alloy, the author of Legend of the Snail. She said her grandfather's latest letter was about #bWing the Fairy of Ellinia#k, and suggested I go see Wing.
QuestInfo.2: Wing the Fairy recalls Alloy as the human who obtained Mano's shell and prolonged his lifespan. Let's ask some more questions.

0.0: I'm busy with preparing for the festival, so please make it quick. What? You're talking about great-grandfather Alloy? Did he get himself into trouble? Phew... that's a relief. It's good to know he is healthy and all, but he sometimes gets into trouble while traveling around the sea.
0.1: I don't know where he is now, because he moves around too much looking for adventures. However, I do have a letter sent from him to me recently. I can show you the letter to you if you'd like.

yes.0: It seems he is in #bEllinia#k now. Apparently, he boasted in his letter that he became friends with #bWing the Fairy#k. Therefore, he has to be in Ellinia with Wing the Fairy. But then again, he does move around a lot, so he may have left Ellinia already.

no.0: Don't blame you if you don't what to know. Could you please move over so I can continue preparing for the festival?

1.0: What... are you? Aren't you human? What's your business here? What? You're asking about Alloy?!

yes.0: How can't I NOT know him?! Every fairy in Ellinia knows him! Don't matter if it's good or bad! He's such a disgusting human! He has a loud voice, too talkative, and he puts his nose into everything he can bug into!
yes.1: Hmm... But he wasn't a bad person at all. Quite funny, in a... strange, sort of way. Underneath the fuss, he was intelligent and wise also. I've heard he got #bMano's Shell#k. Maybe the shell that made him like that? Still, he was a fair guy for a human being.
yes.2: Huh? You don't know what Mano's Shell is? It's the shell of the longest-living snail in Maple World. It's special for its rainbow color. What? You want to see Mano itself? Well... but what for?

npc.0: You haven't met #bWing the Fairy#k yet, haven't you? You don't have to if you don't want to.

item.0: What are your intentions here in the fairy forest, human?
